logline: After finding his girlfriend with another man, a humiliated young man spirals into reckless trading until a mentor teaches him discipline, turning his desperation into confidence and visible gains.

voice_arc: The hero begins with a strained accusation, pauses on wounded questions, then drops into a quiet, angry all-or-nothing decision. The mentor introduces softer, fast, controlled instructions; the hero rises into excited disbelief, dips on “Damn,” and finishes with a strongly projected declaration. Speaker changes within merged transcript segments have approximate timings.
camera_language: The animation uses tight facial reactions and reverse angles to make jealousy and regret immediately readable, with car windows and foreground shoulders framing confrontations. Phone and watch inserts turn money and status into concrete objects, while longer mentor close-ups slow the pace for instruction. Warm beach wides and an upright hero portrait give the emotional recovery a visual finish.
why_it_works: The opening makes the wound visible before explaining it: looming intimacy, a defensive girlfriend and a furious boyfriend establish the conflict quickly. The same emotional volatility then becomes the trading problem, giving the mentor's advice a direct dramatic purpose. A disappointing result interrupts the first win, so the final declaration rewards persistence as well as money.
